description:
Images whose `agency` field names a real space agency (CMSA, SpaceIL, USAF, CSA, Multi-agency, USSR Post) appear under the "Wikimedia Commons contributors" section on the `/credits` page instead of under their own agency section

Expected: Each image on `/credits` should appear under the source-logos section for the space agency that produced/operated/owns the hardware in the photo, not under the conduit platform (Wikimedia Commons) where the bytes were downloaded. The `agencyToSourceId` function in `src/lib/credits-grouping.ts` is the sole runtime routing function.

Acceptance criteria:
- The 135 CMSA-agency entries (Chang'e fleet galleries, Long March, Shenzhou, Tiangong module imagery) must appear under a CMSA section on `/credits`, not under "Wikimedia Commons contributors" [spec: `src/lib/credits-grouping.ts` `agencyToSourceId` docstring: "the upstream publisher (the agency that flew the hardware / produced the image) wins over the retrieval conduit"; `static/data/source-logos.json` has no `cmsa` entry — one must be added]
- The 11 SpaceIL-agency entries (Beresheet fleet gallery) must appear under a SpaceIL section on `/credits` [spec: Same docstring; `static/data/source-logos.json` has no `spaceil` entry — one must be added]
- The 20 USAF-agency entries (X-37B OTV missions) must appear under a U.S. Space Force section on `/credits` [repo-data: `static/data/source-logos.json` has `us-space-force` entry with `name: 'U.S. Space Force'` — `agencyToSourceId` must route `'usaf'` to `'us-space-force'` (USSF absorbed USAF space ops); `agencyToSourceId` currently has `'ussf'` / `'us space force'` / `'united states space force'` but NOT `'usaf'`]
- The 2 CSA / NASA entries (Canadarm2 ISS module imagery) must appear under the Canadian Space Agency section on `/credits` [repo-data: `static/data/source-logos.json` has `csa` entry with `name: 'Canadian Space Agency'`; `agencyToSourceId` must map `'csa'` to `'csa'`; the existing code processes `'CSA / NASA'` via `primary = 'CSA'` then calls `agencyToSourceId('CSA')` which returns `null`]
- The 42 Multi-agency entries and 3 USSR Post entries must not land under Wikimedia Commons as a fallback — they need a named section or be flagged as needs-info [code-invariant: App must not silently misattribute known entities to the wrong source bucket]

Domain facts:
- CMSA = China Manned Space Agency (Shenzhou, Tiangong, Long March crew launchers) — distinct from CNSA (China National Space Administration) which is already mapped
- SpaceIL = Israeli nonprofit lunar-lander operator (Beresheet)
- USAF = United States Air Force — X-37B is a USAF program; the `us-space-force` source-logos entry is the closest existing section given USSF now runs space operations
- CSA = Canadian Space Agency (Canadarm2 on ISS); `source-logos.json` already has `csa` entry but `agencyToSourceId` never maps `'csa'` to it
- `agencyToSourceId` is the single routing function — no changes needed outside `src/lib/credits-grouping.ts` for the mapping, but `source-logos.json` needs a `cmsa` entry and a `spaceil` entry added for those source ids to exist
